about_the_game:
RAISE YOUR FAVORITE CAT!

Dive into a charming world where you can raise lovable cats, collect stunning exotic fish, and connect with a lively global community of players! Forge heartwarming feline friendships, embark on thrilling underwater expeditions to discover rare treasures, and prove your skills as you rise to fame as the most celebrated fishermammal in town.

FISH WITH YOUR CAT!

Travel across picturesque landscapes, from tranquil lakes to bustling seaside harbors, and upgrade your equipment to take on bigger challenges. Complete quests, unlock rare species, and bond with your pet as you uncover the secrets of the aquatic world.

CATCH BIGGEST FISH!

Grab your finest fishing rod, prepare your bait, and head to the water's edge to test your skills. With patience, precision, and a bit of luck, you might just reel in the biggest catch of your life!

PLAY WITH FRIENDS!

Pawfishing is designed around being social and hanging out with friends and strangers in the camp! Meet new people, find hidden spots, make awful fish puns, and catch fish together!
